label: PERFECTION_OF_BEING_2: intensive reading, a perfection of esse itself that the act of being includes
term: intensive reading of perfection of being
definition: `IntensiveEsseFrame.OfEsse d`: d is a perfection of esse itself, a way of being that the act of being includes, so that subsistent esse includes it ('ipsum esse Dei includit in se vitam et sapientiam', ST I q.4 a.2 ad 3). Explicitly primitive. Distinguishing conditions: it is stronger than the thin reading (PERFECTION_OF_BEING_1) and is not implied by reception of esse in essence (R-act₁); the controls of ModeOfBeingMiddleTerm satisfy reception and the purity interfaces while it fails on the thin reading. OPEN: a criterion for which determinations are perfections of esse beyond ad 3's examples.
note: Stipulative analyst primitive, attribution deferred; navigated from I q.4 a.2 ad 3 and I q.4 a.1 ad 3 (materialized SCTA witnesses).
